'''Cinch''' was an [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Cinch was adopted as a pet. However, he was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being.<ref name="Clone Wars Adventures video game" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cinch is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players of the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. It can be bought for 350 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].<ref name="Clone Wars Adventures video game" />
